miniProject.title: Pipeline schedules with validated simulation and measured trade-offs
miniProject.brief: Build pipeline stages and microbatch flow in `trainlab`, validate fill-drain and one-forward-one-backward schedules in an event simulator, and measure schedule trade-offs with equivalence kept. Stalled peers, recompute and group composition turn schedule sketches into runnable evidence.
steps: Partition an ordered layer stack into stages with embedding-first and output-last ownership in `parallel/`, splitting batches into equal microbatches with a stated remainder policy. Anchor the map with the PyTorch pipelining tutorial splits and the TorchFeather microbatch variation, keeping output equality as the gate.

Send activations forward and gradients backward between processes over the Gloo backend with per-microbatch tags and shape assertions, reading stalled peers from event traces. Execute fill-drain and one-forward-one-backward schedules over the pairs, matching losses across schedules as the PyTorch tutorial and TorchFeather run do.

Derive bubble and lifetime predictions for each schedule from the model, and pass the TensorTonic bubble-utilization cases. Encode the schedules as an event simulator in `parallel/` with trace output, live-activation accounting and named rejection of wrong order, short microbatches and stalled peers.

Extend the validated simulator with one interleaved-schedule variant, keeping bubble and memory deltas against the baseline. Place parameters, loss and optimizer state by stage with final-stage loss and a stated tied-weight contract, proving update equivalence against the `model/` oracle with the microbatch-mean scaling correction.

Checkpoint one stage with recompute equivalence checks, and compose pipeline groups with data groups with gradient averaging on the replicate group against the `model/` oracle. Measure bubble, memory, transfer and step time across configurations in `trace/`, keeping equivalence passing and predictions distinct from measurements.
deliverables: The `parallel/` stages, microbatch flow and validated schedule simulator with traces.
Stage ownership, recompute and group-composition proofs against the single-process oracle.
`trace/` and `reports/` with bubble, memory, transfer and step-time comparisons and residuals.

checks.name: PyTorch pipelining tutorial
checks.note: Run both splits and both schedules; gate on matching losses.

checks.name: TorchFeather pipeline GPipe example
checks.note: Run the stock comparison; vary only the microbatch setting.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Measure Pipeline Bubble Utilization
checks.note: Derive answers from the slot model before running the checker.

rubric.pass: Hand traces match simulator cells, and wrong order, short microbatches and stalled peers fail by name.
rubric.strong: The interleaved extension replays with bubble and memory deltas attributed to schedule changes.

rubric.pass: Tagged transfers round-trip with shape agreement, and event logs name the unmatched side.
rubric.strong: A broken-tag run is diagnosed from the trace without rerunning with extra logging.

rubric.pass: Stage state placement is drawn from memory, and updates match the oracle after scaling correction.
rubric.strong: Recompute and group composition keep equivalence, with the averaging group named correctly.

rubric.pass: Every row states its setup, keeps equivalence passing and separates prediction from measurement.
rubric.strong: Residuals name the bottleneck, and one regime where the smaller bubble does not win is kept.

miniProject.feedsInto: The simulator, stage map, ownership proofs and trade-off tables feed composed planning, checkpointing and the capstone.
